workItem: OPS-04-SEC-04 / S1-R2-04: fatal process handling with immediate readiness denial, bounded shutdown delegation and non-zero supervisor exit evidence.
securityBoundary: Fatal uncaught exceptions and unhandled rejections must fail closed: latch readiness unhealthy before shutdown, stop accepting work through the existing SIGTERM server-close path, perform only the existing bounded cleanup, and preserve a non-zero final process exit for Render supervision.
reuseBoundary: Reuse the existing server.application.ts SIGTERM/SIGINT shutdown, outbox stop, timer cleanup and HTTP server drain. Do not create a second shutdown authority or modify deployment/provider state.
externalMutationScope: Repository branch commits only. No Pull Request without the then-current exact-snapshot Human/Owner gate; no merge, deployment, Render, Supabase, Stripe or production mutation.
releaseCondition: Release when the associated Pull Request is Human-merged, closed, superseded or the work item is explicitly abandoned.
